_status: pt name+looks: the fixed CARDS in fine-tuning/translate_pt.py (source of truth). pt today/call, en, sw: draft, not checked by native speakers. The app offers the languages in config.json (pt, en).

pt.name: Folha sadia
pt.looks: Nenhum sinal de doença ou praga.
pt.today: Nada a fazer. Confira algumas folhas de outros pés, inclusive a parte de baixo.
pt.call: Se aparecerem manchas ou pó em outros pés, confira essas folhas também.
pt.source: Sintomas: base de dados BRACOL (Esgario et al., 2020).

en.name: Healthy leaf
en.looks: Evenly green and glossy. No spots, powder, holes or dry patches.
en.today: Nothing to do. Check a few leaves on other trees, including the underside.
en.call: If you see spots or powder on other trees, check those leaves too.

sw.name: Jani lenye afya
sw.looks: Kijani na linang'aa sawasawa. Hakuna madoa, unga, matundu wala sehemu zilizokauka.
sw.today: Hakuna la kufanya. Angalia majani machache ya miti mingine, pamoja na upande wa chini.
sw.call: Ukiona madoa au unga kwenye miti mingine, kagua majani hayo pia.
sw.source: Dalili: hifadhidata ya BRACOL (Esgario na wenzake, 2020).

pt.name: Ferrugem-do-cafeeiro
pt.looks: Manchas alaranjadas e pó na face inferior da folha.
pt.today: Marque este pé. Olhe a parte de baixo das folhas dos pés vizinhos. Recolha as folhas caídas.
pt.call: Chame o técnico agrícola se vários pés tiverem pó, ou se as folhas estiverem caindo antes da hora.
pt.source: Sintomas: BRACOL (Esgario et al., 2020). Orientação: recomendações gerais sobre ferrugem; confirme com a assistência técnica local.

en.name: Coffee leaf rust
en.looks: Yellow-orange powder under the leaf; pale yellow spots on top that turn brown.
en.today: Mark this tree. Check the underside of leaves on the trees next to it. Rake up fallen leaves.
en.call: Call the extension officer if several trees have powder, or leaves are falling early.
en.source: Symptoms: BRACOL (Esgario et al., 2020). Advice: general coffee rust guidance; confirm locally.

sw.name: Kutu ya majani ya kahawa
sw.looks: Unga wa rangi ya njano-machungwa chini ya jani; madoa ya njano juu yanayogeuka kahawia.
sw.today: Weka alama kwenye mti huu. Kagua upande wa chini wa majani ya miti ya jirani. Kusanya majani yaliyoanguka.
sw.call: Mpigie afisa ugani ikiwa miti kadhaa ina unga, au majani yanaanguka mapema.
sw.source: Dalili: BRACOL (Esgario na wenzake, 2020). Ushauri: mwongozo wa jumla wa kutu ya kahawa; thibitisha kwa wataalamu wa eneo lako.

pt.name: Cercosporiose (mancha-de-olho-pardo)
pt.looks: Manchas marrons redondas com centro claro e halo amarelo.
pt.today: Veja se este pé pega sol forte o dia todo ou parece mal nutrido. Mantenha cobertura morta em volta do tronco.
pt.call: Chame o técnico agrícola se as manchas aparecerem também nos frutos.
pt.source: Sintomas: BRACOL (Esgario et al., 2020). Orientação: recomendações gerais sobre cercosporiose; confirme com a assistência técnica local.

en.name: Brown eye spot (Cercospora)
en.looks: Small round brown spots with a light grey centre, often with a yellow ring.
en.today: Check whether this tree gets full sun all day or looks underfed. Keep mulch around the base.
en.call: Call the extension officer if the spots also appear on the coffee cherries.
en.source: Symptoms: BRACOL (Esgario et al., 2020). Advice: general Cercospora guidance; confirm locally.

sw.name: Madoa ya jicho kahawia (Cercospora)
sw.looks: Madoa madogo ya mviringo ya kahawia yenye kitovu cha kijivu, mara nyingi na pete ya njano.
sw.today: Angalia kama mti huu unapata jua kali siku nzima au unaonekana kukosa chakula. Weka matandazo kuzunguka shina.
sw.call: Mpigie afisa ugani ikiwa madoa yanaonekana pia kwenye matunda ya kahawa.
sw.source: Dalili: BRACOL (Esgario na wenzake, 2020). Ushauri: mwongozo wa jumla wa Cercospora; thibitisha kwa wataalamu wa eneo lako.

pt.name: Mancha-de-phoma
pt.looks: Áreas escuras, quase pretas, geralmente na borda ou na ponta da folha.
pt.today: Anote onde fica este pé na lavoura. Veja se ele pega vento frio.
pt.call: Chame o técnico agrícola se os brotos novos estiverem secando.
pt.source: Sintomas: BRACOL (Esgario et al., 2020). Orientação: recomendações gerais sobre Phoma; confirme com a assistência técnica local.

en.name: Phoma leaf spot
en.looks: Dark brown to black dead patches with uneven edges, often starting at the tip or edge.
en.today: Note where on the farm this tree is. Check if it is exposed to cold wind.
en.call: Call the extension officer if young shoots are dying back.
en.source: Symptoms: BRACOL (Esgario et al., 2020). Advice: general Phoma guidance; confirm locally.

sw.name: Madoa ya Phoma
sw.looks: Sehemu zilizokufa za kahawia iliyokolea hadi nyeusi, kingo zisizo sawa, mara nyingi zikianzia ncha au ukingo.
sw.today: Kumbuka mti huu uko wapi shambani. Angalia kama unapigwa na upepo baridi.
sw.call: Mpigie afisa ugani ikiwa machipukizi machanga yanakauka.
sw.source: Dalili: BRACOL (Esgario na wenzake, 2020). Ushauri: mwongozo wa jumla wa Phoma; thibitisha kwa wataalamu wa eneo lako.

pt.name: Bicho-mineiro
pt.looks: Manchas marrons secas e irregulares, causadas por larvas dentro da folha.
pt.today: Em pé pouco atacado, retire as folhas minadas e destrua-as. Não pulverize sem orientação: o veneno também mata os insetos que comem o bicho-mineiro.
pt.call: Chame o técnico agrícola se muitas folhas, em muitos pés, estiverem minadas.
pt.source: Sintomas: BRACOL (Esgario et al., 2020). Orientação: recomendações gerais sobre bicho-mineiro; confirme com a assistência técnica local.

en.name: Leaf miner
en.looks: Light brown, dry, papery patches of uneven shape; the surface can peel off.
en.today: On a lightly affected tree, pick the mined leaves and destroy them. Avoid spraying without advice; it also kills the insects that eat leaf miners.
en.call: Call the extension officer if many leaves on many trees are mined.
en.source: Symptoms: BRACOL (Esgario et al., 2020). Advice: general leaf miner guidance; confirm locally.

sw.name: Mchimba jani
sw.looks: Sehemu za kahawia hafifu, kavu kama karatasi, zisizo na umbo maalum; ngozi ya jani inaweza kubanduka.
sw.today: Kwenye mti ulioathirika kidogo, chuma majani yaliyochimbwa na uyaharibu. Usinyunyize dawa bila ushauri; inaua pia wadudu wanaokula mchimba jani.
sw.call: Mpigie afisa ugani ikiwa majani mengi kwenye miti mingi yamechimbwa.
sw.source: Dalili: BRACOL (Esgario na wenzake, 2020). Ushauri: mwongozo wa jumla wa mchimba jani; thibitisha kwa wataalamu wa eneo lako.

pt.name: Não tenho certeza
pt.looks: Mostre a folha a um técnico agrícola.
pt.today: Tire a foto de novo: uma folha só, ocupando a foto, com boa luz.
pt.call: Ainda sem certeza? A foto foi salva. Mostre a folha ao técnico agrícola; ela será enviada quando houver sinal.
pt.source: O aplicativo só responde quando tem confiança suficiente. Quem decide é uma pessoa.

en.name: Not sure
en.looks: It cannot tell from this photo, so it will not guess.
en.today: Take the photo again: one leaf, filling the photo, in good light.
en.call: Still not sure? The photo is saved. Show the leaf to the extension officer; it will be sent when there is signal.
en.source: The tool only answers when it is confident enough. A person makes the final call.

sw.name: Sina uhakika
sw.looks: Hakiwezi kujua kutokana na picha hii, kwa hiyo hakitabahatisha.
sw.today: Piga picha tena: jani moja, lijaze picha, kwenye mwanga mzuri.
sw.call: Bado hakuna uhakika? Picha imehifadhiwa. Mwonyeshe afisa ugani jani hili; itatumwa mtandao ukipatikana.
sw.source: Kifaa hujibu tu kikiwa na uhakika wa kutosha. Uamuzi wa mwisho ni wa mtu.
